rules.accepted_credit_types: Approved program types listed in Board rule 295.8(e); most common ACPE; also AMA PRA Category 1 / CME
rules.new_licensee_rule: Initial renewal period (18–30 months, aligned to birth month): exempt from most CE, but 2 hours of prescribing and monitoring controlled substances within the first year of licensure (licensed on/after Sept 1, 2020) and one HHSC-approved human trafficking course.
rules.audit_note: CE compliance must show "Complete" in CE Broker before renewal (SB 912, 2025); CPE Monitor transcripts can be uploaded. Keep certificates 3 years; Board audits.

topics.who: Texas pharmacy laws or rules (not general/federal law)
One Texas HHSC-approved course; counts toward 30 h only if accredited for pharmacists
New pharmacists licensed on or after Sept 1, 2020: prescribing and monitoring controlled substances within the first year
Immunization-certified pharmacists: extra CE for the certification, may count within the 30

rules.notes: Special certifications (immunization, sterile compounding, preceptor, drug therapy management) carry extra CE that may count within the 30 hours.
